statement: Let n grow through powers of two, ell=ceil(log2 n), and q(n) be the least prime congruent to1 modulo2n^3. For either separately chosen d(n)=floor(sqrt(n)/ell^4) or d(n)=floor(n/(64ell)), pseudorandomness of the exact Base2(n,q(n),d(n)) source implies negligible actual-secret recovery by every uniform PPT solver from exactly m in {1,2} rank-one coefficient-binary RLWE samples with independent uniform multipliers and fully independent coefficient D_sigma_m errors, sigma_m=2sqrt(m)n ell^3. Each d choice is its own source assumption; no other polynomial-q family, extra target samples or decision claim is inferred.
explicit_computational_hypothesis: Pseudorandomness of Base2(n,q(n),d(n)) at the chosen source family; this hypothesis is assumed, not proved or renamed analytic premise.
scope_repair_only: Frozen theorem-only-v2/proof-v1/supplement-v1 unchanged; the ledger now states their concrete prime sequence explicitly.
